memory_atoms.title: Match technical clue words at token boundaries
memory_atoms.rule: A technical clue must match a complete word or phrase. A substring inside an unrelated word is not a valid route or nomenclature clue.

memory_atoms.title: Partial identifiers must look like identifiers
memory_atoms.rule: Do not convert ordinary prose into a partial part number. A partial identifier clue must be explicitly entity-bound and identifier-shaped, normally including at least one digit.
examples: contain the strongest evidence must not extract THE

memory_atoms.title: Explicit topical discovery outranks incidental component nouns
triggers: even when the exact phrase is not used
memory_atoms.rule: When the user explicitly asks for topical or concept-level page discovery, route semantically even if the query also contains component nouns such as seat, panel, ring, or cover.
examples: Find pages about corrosion prevention for passenger seats routes semantic
The noun seat alone does not turn a topical search into part discovery

memory_atoms.title: Remove explicitly mismatched entity evidence
memory_atoms.rule: Evidence that explicitly names only different part numbers is irrelevant to an exact-part claim and must be removed before rendering, even when labeled guidance-only.
examples: A request for 120-41824-003 must not surface a figure containing only 120-41824-217
Safe but irrelevant evidence is still bad evidence

memory_atoms.title: Decompose multi-question research by claim type
memory_atoms.rule: Split a multi-question request into bounded claim-specific searches and validate evidence separately for exact identity, table value, visual identity, relationships, and authority.
examples: Part identity and replacement approval require separate evidence gates
A figure result cannot satisfy an authority claim

memory_atoms.title: Try the specialized tunnel before broad semantic fallback
memory_atoms.rule: A specialized route should attempt its typed retrieval tunnel and source resolution before settling for broad semantic guidance.
examples: An IPL item request should try table rows and cells
A warning request should try warning blocks before generic page similarity

memory_atoms.title: Keep guidance useful without promoting it
memory_atoms.rule: Candidate, visual, semantic, graph, summary, and unresolved OCR evidence may guide retrieval but cannot prove a technical claim. State what was found, what remains unproven, and the next evidence needed.
examples: A visual association can guide the user to a page without proving nomenclature
A candidate list is not a final identification

memory_atoms.title: Authority claims require explicit authority evidence
memory_atoms.rule: Approval, replacement, interchangeability, effectivity, applicability, eligibility, fit, and installation claims require explicit current source authority; similarity and shared nomenclature are not enough.
examples: A shared part family does not prove interchangeability
No authority evidence means no approval claim
